info.title: GS HRMS API
info.description:
API for GS HRMS. **Generated from the code** — every endpoint must be documented (CI checks it).
Business rules and flows: `docs/modules/*.md` and the PDFs in `flow/`. Testing guide: `docs/api-guide.md`.

### Try it in 3 steps
1. Open **Auth → POST /api/auth/dev/login**, click **Try it out**, send `{ "employeeCode": "GS-120" }`.
   The session cookie is now set in this browser.
2. Call any endpoint with **Try it out** — you are signed in as that persona.
3. Switch persona by signing in again (GS-119 HR · GS-101 Office Admin · GS-058 Team Lead · GS-087 Employee).

### Errors
Every error has the same body: `{ statusCode, code, message, details?, requestId }`. Switch on `code`.

code.description: Stable code — the frontend switches on this

message.example: You do not have access to this

requestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem

employeeCode.description: Employee code of a seeded persona

location.description: A location id, or "Both" for every location

timezone.description: IANA timezone — leave and attendance days use it

phoneDigits.description: Digits in a local phone number, 6–15

seating.description: Seats employees can be given; unique ignoring case

template.description: Employee form rules: UAE (visa, Emirates ID, WPS) or INDIA (Aadhaar, PAN, PF)
